brief: 6 mindset shifts that changed everything for me at 30.

slots.title: MINDSET SHIFTS THAT CHANGED EVERYTHING AT THIRTY
FAILURE IS FEEDBACK
slots.body: Every stumble became a lesson once I stopped taking it personally. Now I treat mistakes as market research for my life.

slots.title: PERFECTION KILLS PROGRESS
slots.body: I used to polish projects until the opportunity vanished. Shipping messy work taught me that momentum beats perfection every time.

slots.title: BOUNDARIES BUILD FREEDOM
slots.body: Saying no used to terrify me. Once I honored my time, the right people and projects showed up without resentment.

slots.title: WORTH COMES FIRST
slots.body: Chasing money from a place of scarcity only created more lack. I started charging what I deserved and abundance followed.

slots.title: REST IS STRATEGIC
slots.body: Burnout was my default mode until my body forced a pause. Scheduled recovery now produces my clearest thinking and best ideas.

slots.title: YOUR PAST ISN'T PERMANENT
slots.body: I carried old stories like a badge of honor. Rewriting my narrative at thirty gave me permission to become someone new.
